description: C65 — 链接双车 - 第6局：逐步清空底线（鲁伊·洛佩兹C65变例）

intro.popup_en:
Connect the Rooks, Practice 6
How many pieces are still blocking the back rank from connecting the rooks? Follow the development: as the pieces move out, the rooks become connected naturally.
intro.popup:
链接双车练习6
问：底线有几个障碍阻挡双车连接？
跟随每一步，看子力协调快速发展，双车自然连接！

outro.popup_en: Summary: develop the pieces and connect the rooks. Rfe1 finally links the rook from a1 with the rook on e1.
outro.popup:
总结：快速发展子力同时联通双车
Rfe1！Ra1与Re1真正连通！

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles, but three pieces still block the back rank: the knight on b1, bishop on c1, and queen on d1. The rooks are not connected yet.
moves.popup:
O-O易位！
但底线还有3个障碍：
①马在b1  ②象在c1  ③后在d1
双车尚未连接！

moves.popup_en: Nc3! The knight leaves b1. Only the bishop on c1 and queen on d1 still block the back rank.
...O-O! Black has also castled, so both kings are safe.
moves.popup: 黑方也完成易位！双方棋王都安全

moves.popup_en: Bg5! The bishop leaves c1. Only the queen on d1 remains in the way.
Qd3! The queen leaves d1. Squares b1, c1, and d1 are now clear, so the rooks can connect as White develops.
moves.popup:
Qd3！后离开d1
b1✓ c1✓ d1✓
 出子的同时， 车自然连接！

moves.popup_en: Qe2 continues to reposition the queen. The d1-square stays clear, so the rooks are ready to connect.
moves.popup:
Qe2！后继续调整
d1依然空着，连接条件成熟

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black activates a rook on the e-file as well.
Rfe1! The rooks are connected: the route from a1 to e1 is clear because b1, c1, and d1 have been vacated. Development has naturally connected the rooks.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！双车连接完成！
Ra1——b1空——c1空——d1空——Re1
双车自然连通！
